events.text: The {{USS|George Washington|CVN-73|6}} arrives in the Middle East to relieve the {{USS|Abraham Lincoln|CVN-72|6}} amidst a nine-month deployment and reports of mental health challenges and supplies shortages on the aircraft carrier during t
The Israel Defense Forces accuses Hamas of using the Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis to carry out interrogations and torture Palestinians.
Human Rights Watch reports that Africa Corps forces summarily killed nine civilians, including four children, including four children, in Mali last month.
LSEG data shows that a vessel in France is loading wheat destined for Sudan, the first export of wheat from France to Sudan since August 2008.
Four railway workers on the Tōbu Nikkō Line are killed after being struck by a Limited express train in Kanuma, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan.
A {{M|w|6.7}} earthquake strikes the Parinacochas province in Peru.

A Chinese court sentences Evergrande founder Hui Ka Yan to life imprisonment for financial fraud, bribery, and embezzlement, and fines Evergrande and its real estate arm a combined ¥15.8 billion (US$2.35 billion).
The Jatiya Sangsad elects Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as the President of Bangladesh in the first contested presidential election in 35 years.
